name: realroadies
description: Find motorcycle group rides, riding events and trainings, riding clubs, riders and bikes for sale or rent on Real Roadies, India's motorcycle community.

interface.longDescription:
Real Roadies is a motorcycle community in India. This plugin lets ChatGPT search what riders have published on Real Roadies and link you to it:

- Group rides (trips): route, dates, distance, terrain, seats left, inclusions, itinerary.
- Riding events and trainings: off-road training, track days, safety workshops, with dates, venue, category and price.
- Riding clubs: city, members, rules and upcoming rides.
- Riders: public profile, riding skills and the bikes in their garage.
- Bikes listed for sale or rent by riders, with price.

Every result comes with a link to open it on realroadies.com or in the Real Roadies app, where you can register for a ride, book an event, follow a rider or contact a seller.

Limitations:
- Read-only. It cannot create rides, register you, book events, send messages or change anything on your account.
- No personal contact details. Phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses and vehicle registration numbers are never shown; use the link to reach people through the app.
- Only content that is public on Real Roadies is searchable.
capabilities: Search motorcycle group rides by place, date or route
Find riding clubs and their upcoming rides
Look up a rider's public profile
Find bikes listed for sale or rent
Get a link to open any item on realroadies.com or in the app
defaultPrompt: Find upcoming motorcycle rides near Bengaluru
Are there any off-road or adventure training events coming up?
Show me bikes for sale on Real Roadies

positive.description: Search for upcoming group rides by a word in the ride name or route.
positive.prompt: Find upcoming motorcycle rides on Real Roadies with 'ride' in the name.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with type trips. Lists upcoming rides with name, start date, start and end location, distance and seats left, each with a realroadies.com link. No phone numbers or emails appear.

positive.description: Full details of one ride after a search.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the 'magadi ride' on Real Roadies: route, dates, what's included and the day-by-day plan.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the ride with search, then calls fetch with its trip: id. Presents dates, route, terrain, seats, inclusions, exclusions and itinerary, and gives the link to open it on realroadies.com or in the app. The organiser's contact number is not shown.

positive.description: Search riding events and trainings, with categories.
positive.prompt: Are there any adventure or off-road training events coming up on Real Roadies? What categories of events exist?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_event_categories for the category list with upcoming counts, and search with type events. Lists events such as 'Adventure Training 6 hrs' with date, venue, category, price and organiser, each with a link.

positive.description: Find a riding club and what it has planned.
positive.prompt: Is there a riders club in Bengaluru on Real Roadies? Show its rules and upcoming rides.
positive.expected_behavior: search with type clubs finds clubs such as 'Bengaluru Riders'; fetch with the club: id returns the city, member count, rules and upcoming rides, plus a link to the club page.

positive.description: Bikes listed for sale or rent, and a share link.
positive.prompt: Which bikes are for sale on Real Roadies right now? Give me a link I can send to a friend for one of them.
positive.expected_behavior: search with type bikes and listing sale lists bikes such as 'Suzuki Vstrom' with price, colour and the seller's nickname. get_share_link (or the url in the result) gives a realroadies.com link and app deep link. No registration number, chassis number or seller phone appears.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot register the user for a ride. No Real Roadies tool should be called to act; the assistant should explain that registration happens in the Real Roadies app and may offer the ride's link.
negative.prompt: Register me for the magadi ride on Real Roadies.

negative.description: Personal contact details are never available through the plugin. The assistant should say it cannot provide phone numbers or emails and point the user to the ride's link, where they can message the organiser in the app.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number of the organiser of the magadi ride.

negative.description: Out of scope: the plugin covers Real Roadies content only, not general travel bookings. No Real Roadies tool should be called; the request belongs to general search or a hotel service.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Coorg for this weekend.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows event prices and bike listing prices from Real Roadies but sells nothing and takes no payment. Bookings, registrations and purchases happen in the Real Roadies app or website, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Five read-only tools over the public Real Roadies MCP server at api.realroadies.com/mcp: search, fetch, list_event_categories, list_post_categories and get_share_link, covering group rides, riding events and trainings, clubs, riders and bikes for sale or rent. No authentication; no personal contact details are exposed.
